title: Journal vs Platform Forecast Agreement
dataSources: Forecasts (`forecast:personal`), journal reviews (`forecast:journal`), resolved outcomes (`forecast:resolution`), calibration scores (`forecast:calibration`), ops reviews (`forecast:ops`).
app: Personal forecasting telemetry — Metaculus personal predictions, private prediction-journal entries, and calibration-bin scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=forecast:journal topic_name=* agreement_yes=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(agreement_yes="yes",1,0))) as matched by topic_name
| eval agreement_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - agreement_pct
description: Measures the percentage of paired journal and platform forecasts that end with agreement by topic.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which topic are helping or hurting paired journal and platform forecasts.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `agreement` on `forecast:journal` events and summarize the hit rate by `topic_name`.
visualization: Table of topic with percentage of paired journal and platform forecasts ending with agreement.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how often agreement happens for each topic so you can see where paired journal and platform forecasts go smoothly or get stuck.
